series.title: The Lantern Mender of Pell Street
series.logline: A burned-out hospital electrician wakes in a lamplit market town where she is the only person who can repair 'memory lanterns', and each fix shows her the owner's last secret.
series.hook: A new small mystery every arc, one slow-burn pair, and a Mending meter that unlocks deeper lanterns, leading toward whoever has been smashing the town's memories.

episodes.title: Half Past Too Late
episodes.blurb: Ada Brannock wakes on a stranger's workshop floor in a town with a stopped clock, a shut road and a man who needs a lantern mended before he forgets her.

episodes.title: Nothing Happened
episodes.blurb: The woman from the canal is alive, dim-lantern complaints and all, and has no idea why she buys for two. Ada has a date, a friend, and a very long list of things the town will not say.

episodes.title: For the Record
episodes.blurb: Ada has sixteen warm pieces of a lantern nobody remembers owning, a Registrar who answers everything "for the record", and a ledger with one line left blank.

episodes.title: A Gap in the Glass
episodes.blurb: Ada has half a name and sixteen shards on the bench. At ninth bell, with Emrys keeping the record, she mends. Some things come back with a gap in them.

episodes.title: Below the Wick
episodes.blurb: Ada is bound by a charter and handed the Provost's own dimming lantern. Some mends cost more than a memory.

episodes.title: A Wheel Short of Done
episodes.blurb: Ada cannot say what she saw in the Provost's lantern, so she sends Emrys to the records. Then the clock tower, and a lantern far above her tier.

episodes.title: Pretty Glass
episodes.blurb: Ada finds Tobias at the top of the clock tower, unsure of his own name, and a ferryman opens a tin of pretty glass.

episodes.title: Dark Lamps
episodes.blurb: Emrys crosses the water to ask who lit the lamps on Flood Night. A drowned bargeman's lantern answers part of it.

episodes.title: Somebody Will Want It
episodes.blurb: Ada takes a hem note to the Provost and the square hears the rest. Some truths clear the air; the next one is under the floor.

episodes.title: The Last Hand
episodes.blurb: A name in an old log that nobody knows, a lamp house shut for ten years, and a last mend that costs Ada one more thing.

series.title: Branch Cartographer
series.logline: Fintan Ardent maps neighbouring worlds that differ from ours by one decision, and every crossing swaps one small fact of his life with his counterpart's. He is climbing the Survey ranks and discovering that someone has been pruning branches.
series.hook: Each survey pins a new branch and a clever use of the swap rule. Ranks open farther branches, and the season payoff is who prunes the branches and what happens to the worlds they cut.

episodes.title: Chapter 1: Hinge-Maker: Blank
episodes.blurb: A trainee surveyor's first provisional card has one field left blank, and filling it will cost him more than he was told.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: What the Lamplighter Lost
episodes.blurb: A lamplighter loses one memory a week and wakes holding another man's childhood, and Fintan has until the next midnight to find whose.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Fourteen Lamps and No Bridge
episodes.blurb: A trainee surveyor crosses to a Ferrytown without a bridge, and one picked-up pebble costs his pilot her oldest memory.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: The Third Door
episodes.blurb: With Saltings shut to him and a doorway three days from being bricked up, Fintan sends his crew to every door but the one on his own street.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: Measuring Decay
episodes.blurb: Fintan goes to Greyfell to measure a dead branch's decay, and a whole branch stops in a single breath.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: Back Early
episodes.blurb: A packet seal sits three degrees off true, and the wax leads Fintan to Weirside and a door he was told to leave shut.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Source Unknown
episodes.blurb: Cressida wakes remembering her mother's face, and Fintan traces it to a falling branch and a question she will not answer.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: The Treat Crossing
episodes.blurb: A nine-year-old asks what time the treat crossing leaves, and a scarfed stranger has promised her a door at ten.

episodes.title: Chapter 9: Three Kinds, Three Days
episodes.blurb: Fintan sits the Chainman's Walk with ballast he made himself, and someone has slipped a letter into his folder.

episodes.title: Chapter 10: Reverse Order
episodes.blurb: Fintan crosses alone to win his name back and finds it has already travelled somewhere he cannot follow.

series.title: The Knot Clerk
series.logline: Ila Brandt, a junior clerk at the Bureau of Causal Repair, learns that coincidences are knots in cause and effect and that fixing one means spending another. Her first solo repair goes wrong in a way the Bureau says is impossible.
series.hook: Every episode untangles one knotted coincidence with a bigger trick, and each fix pays a visible cost. The payoff is who knotted the world's first cause, and why the Bureau exists to keep it hidden.

episodes.title: Plain as You Like
episodes.blurb: A junior clerk unties two strands of umbrella trouble on a quiet set of steps, and the man at the centre of it stops breathing.

episodes.title: The Wrong Wanting
episodes.blurb: The man she thought she killed is alive and waiting, her slack is due before noon, and a hearing is about to decide what she really wanted.

episodes.title: A Crime in My Hand
episodes.blurb: A suspended clerk climbs the hill to a garden of illegal knots, and the only teacher who will take her asks her to sign her name to a crime.

episodes.title: The Name Rides
episodes.blurb: Ila signs her own name to a stranger's knot, and the slack that falls lands on her father's workbench, while a dead man pours her tea.

episodes.title: A Stone Gone Walking
episodes.blurb: A yellow cobble has vanished from Orla's garden row, and Ila's hunt for the thief leads to a confession about Cuthbert and a map with one street at its heart.

episodes.title: A Consideration
episodes.blurb: Ila finds out who made the luckiest courier in Brindlemouth lucky, and for the first time she breaks the rulebook rather than follow it.

episodes.title: The Sour Book
episodes.blurb: A baker's lad lies hurt under a fallen shop sign, asking who Leonard Pask is, and the pad of pre-written dockets Ila uncovers has one name left to fill.

episodes.title: The Good Cabinet
episodes.blurb: Ila sneaks into Field Allocation for proof, and finds the file that was written about her before she ever picked up a fid.

episodes.title: What the Carbon Kept
episodes.blurb: Mags finally opens the union's thirty-year-old box, and what the carbon copy says about the Corn Exchange keeper has Ila walking into her father's lock-up.

episodes.title: The Wrong Mile
episodes.blurb: Ila has one morning to stop a snare aimed at her friend, and her perfect plan is guarding the wrong mile.

series.title: The Fifth-Floor Tenant
series.logline: Broke night-shift building super Ravi Anand finds his apartment block is a tiered dungeon the city keeps hidden, and that he is its caretaker. Each floor he cleans, patches and rezones raises his rank and the building's.
series.hook: How high the building goes, what lives at the top, and why the city needed a caretaker who is unlicensed and underpaid.

episodes.title: Chapter 1: Dry by Morning
episodes.blurb: A night caretaker promises a tenant her kitchen wall will be dry by morning, then follows the leak to a floor that is not on any drawing.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: Retained
episodes.blurb: The dog on floor 5 has rules for Ravi, and one he won't explain.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Cause Unseen
episodes.blurb: Ravi blames the thing that chews, and a stranger knows his surname.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: The Middle of the Rope
episodes.blurb: The key-eaters lose their dispute but win Ravi a deeper culprit, and the pipe's real tenant has already filed a complaint against him.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: Old Brass, Freely Given
episodes.blurb: The order Ravi handed back has come back worse, and the only fix he can find is metal that has to be given freely.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: Dry by Midnight
episodes.blurb: Ravi has until midnight to keep a promise to a mould, and when it is kept the lift grows a new button.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Holding Two
episodes.blurb: Ravi trusts a stamp on a box of brass, and by morning the east stair is cracking and the book won't take his name.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: What the Stair Stands On
episodes.blurb: Ravi has a free slot for the cracked east stair, but not yet any idea what it stands on.

episodes.title: Chapter 9: A Very Tidy Cause
episodes.blurb: Ravi names the firm behind the cracked east stair and sends the proof across the city by courier, but a midnight ruling can hand the weight straight back.

episodes.title: Chapter 10: The Usual Arrangement
episodes.blurb: The east stair is mended by morning, but a clerk arrives with a tenant roll and an offer Ravi knows is real.

series.title: Wrong Side of the Sun
series.logline: Captain Peregrine Blott and the crew of the courier ship Postscript run freight between worlds that never agreed on what year it is, because light-lag makes every colony's calendar a different truth. A parcel arrives dated from the future.
series.hook: Each delivery is a puzzle of causality that the crew solves by exploiting relativistic mail rules. The season arc peels back a lie: someone is editing the colonies' shared history through the post.

episodes.title: Postmarked Next Year
episodes.blurb: A sealed cask in the keel locker is postmarked from this very ship, nineteen months in the future.

episodes.title: Noted, and Not Agreed
episodes.blurb: An Inspector who does not believe in perfect records goes through every spool aboard Postscript while a sack of ballots races a midnight rule change.

episodes.title: The Gift and the Bargain
episodes.blurb: A dying passenger wants her last letter to arrive before she does, and a postmaster shows Peregrine a trick that is perfectly legal.

episodes.title: A Berth by the Hour
episodes.blurb: A dockmaster's claim race ends at a Register screen that names the one courier who should never have been there.

episodes.title: Sharp Practice
episodes.blurb: A queen bee, a sixty-day permit and a seventy-day haul: the Code is very particular about letters.

episodes.title: The Cold Hull
episodes.blurb: When Postscript's drive goes cold in the Lee, a very polite stranger comes aboard and the courier who has never been late is handed one more letter to carry.

episodes.title: The Courier's Receipt
episodes.blurb: A returned letter is finally opened the way the Code intended, and the name in it makes a captain stop moving.

episodes.title: The Second Courier
episodes.blurb: Revision 63 is posted and a very kind deputy has sent a second courier to Folio, so Postscript has to beat him there with four thousand names.

episodes.title: Delivered Before It Left
episodes.blurb: A petition comes back from a counter it has not yet reached, and the last spool is spent on a legal trick that costs the courier his clean record.

episodes.title: Returned to Sender
episodes.blurb: The season finale: a grey cask crosses the collar, a recording is played to the one person it was meant for, and the last bag goes home to Quarto.

series.title: The Reckoner of the Thirteenth Hour
series.logline: In the stopped hour between midnight and one, a hidden league plays Lull with borrowed seconds. A night-shift auditor becomes its Reckoner, the player who keeps the count and sees what the seconds really cost.
series.hook: Climb the Hour Divisions from the Stairwell League to the Midnight Final by out-counting everyone, while uncovering who is stealing the thirteenth hour from the city.

episodes.title: Chapter 1: The Emergency Reckoner
episodes.blurb: A night auditor passed over for her own job is handed a brass key at nine o'clock and must Reckon for a failing side at midnight.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: Declared, Not Signed
episodes.blurb: Petra refuses the clerk's wording, and the Bank gives her until midnight to sign a lie.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: A Stalled Sleeper Never Wakes
episodes.blurb: Petra's crew books the first dead-time Stall Book against a side that has never conceded to four, and the Bank's governor walks in at the Close.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: What Coyle Knows
episodes.blurb: Hester Coyle swears she will call her Audit tonight, and Petra has a jar she has not dared to weigh.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: The Slow Clock
episodes.blurb: Lisle confesses a debt that is falling on her without warning, and the tram-stop clock is running slow.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: Whose Seconds Are These
episodes.blurb: Petra accuses the wrong teammate before a match against the Guild's own side, and the truth arrives too late to save the night.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Three Hours Owed
episodes.blurb: Petra learns where the seconds come from, and Tran's debt of sleep comes due on the plate.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: The Sum Tran Hid
episodes.blurb: Tran has been lying about how much sleep he owes, and Petra has two nights to get him under the bench line before the last matchday.

episodes.title: Chapter 9: A Full Box, Still Warm
episodes.blurb: The night before the playoff, Drewe puts Mabry's full, warm box on Petra's desk and repeats the order that would hand Wardle a Pool Fraud Audit.

episodes.title: Chapter 10: Figures at the Guild Door
episodes.blurb: Petra wins the Daylight Playoff on the Ninth Stair, opens the clock that cost her a post, and at dawn is asked to audit the Reserve.

series.title: Down Is Where I Say
series.logline: In a mining town's abandoned shafts, the sport Plumb decides which way is down. A shaft-lift operator's daughter becomes the Anchor, the only player who can hold gravity still for her team, and every hour makes her heavier.
series.hook: Descend the shaft tiers from Shaft Nine to the Deepest Cup, outsmarting stronger players with vector maths and nerve, and learn what the first miners were holding down.

episodes.title: Eighty Crowns on the Ninepins
episodes.blurb: Dagny Quillon has never held a Pin in a match, but her brother has borrowed eighty crowns against a team that just lost its Anchor.

episodes.title: What the Water Knew
episodes.blurb: Dagny wakes to water that runs uphill to her feet, and the one man who can name it has never seen anyone come back.

episodes.title: Next One by the Spot
episodes.blurb: Dagny has to pass a doctor's plumb-bob to play on, and then a fast Tanners Anchor and a coin in the wrong hand show her how much can be counted but not controlled.

episodes.title: The Letgo Is a Place
episodes.blurb: Dagny holds a dead-still Cob for five minutes against a team that has done this before, and the bell is about to teach her what she didn't know.

episodes.title: Heavier Every Monday
episodes.blurb: Dagny gives up two zones to hold one, and the sum she does out loud shows her who has been throwing Drops, but the Weighman has been doing sums of his own.

episodes.title: Where Nothing Falls
episodes.blurb: Dagny finds a way to make a whole shaft hold still, but the cost of keeping a friend's secret is climbing faster than her weight.

episodes.title: Nine Pounds Short of Heavy
episodes.blurb: Dagny is nine pounds from Heavy with two Drops left, and the one man who could drain her has just shown her what his chair is really made of.

episodes.title: Hold, and Don't Look Down
episodes.blurb: Dagny has to win on nothing but trust and a hair's turn, because one paid pound tips her Heavy, and Pru has been keeping a secret since the night it all began.

episodes.title: Fifteen Counts
episodes.blurb: A stuck cage, a worn cable and one rescue Pin give Dagny fifteen counts to spend, and the league's next notice leaves her nowhere to hide.

episodes.title: Sudden Drop
episodes.blurb: Tied at four-all with every Pin let go, Dagny has one throw left and a debt that is nearly paid.

series.title: Dead Air
series.logline: A half-deaf stonemason's apprentice feels sound through their feet, and in Quell, the cellar-league sport where sound is a physical wave, the only job they can win is Damper: standing in the way of every note.
series.hook: Climb from the Cellar Ring to the Cathedral Cup by out-reading physics, not out-hitting anyone, while uncovering what the Drum buried under the city was built to ring.

episodes.title: Four Seconds
episodes.blurb: A mason with a debt takes one night's work standing in front of notes that ruin bodies, and has four seconds to decide what to do with the biggest one.

episodes.title: Stand Like That
episodes.blurb: Wren's hands won't hold a chisel, the bailiff is counting down, and the one man who could coach the side comes down the stair to ask who taught Wren to stand.

episodes.title: Half a Wave
episodes.blurb: Someone keeps chalking drills on Wren's bench, and in the Ropewalk Drum Wren must trust a partner's timing to the instant.

episodes.title: Nothing, Halloway
episodes.blurb: Barefoot in front of a laughing gallery, Wren finds a way to kill a note in mid-air, and a stranger in the front row has been watching her feet.

episodes.title: Wet Floor, Cold Feet
episodes.blurb: Wren's pairs fail on a sweating floor at Wellhead, and the cause points somewhere much closer to home.

episodes.title: Flat Where It Rang
episodes.blurb: The Last Stand rang true yesterday; this morning it rocks, and the match is in three hours.

episodes.title: The Count That Isn't Mine
episodes.blurb: Glasshouse take away Wren's warning, and the only way through is to draw on someone else's count.

episodes.title: Nearly True
episodes.blurb: Quist gives Wren one rule, Old Mint throws a note nobody can feel coming, and a courteous letter arrives with a bell on its seal.

episodes.title: A Peg in Plain Sight
episodes.blurb: The unbeaten Tannery Hounds throw notes no pair can null, so Kilnyard leaves the Dead Air on the shelf and bets everything on a peg in plain sight.

episodes.title: The Warm Wall
episodes.blurb: The Chapterhouse wall is warm, every stand pair is wrong, and the floor has something to say.

series.title: Seven Neighbours
series.logline: Sorrel Quint, a pigeon-loft hand, becomes Lead Wing of a marsh-circuit side in Murmur, where the ball is a flock of forty starlings and the Wing steers it by reading seven birds. Her club is one defeat from the drop.
series.hook: Climb from the Marsh Circuit to the Sky Division by learning how a flock thinks, while finding out why the count is always one bird too many.

episodes.title: Chapter 1: Forty-One Over the Reedbed
episodes.blurb: The Circuit Loft's spare hand counts forty-one birds over a failing fen, and the official counter writes down forty.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: Copper on the Wrist
episodes.blurb: Sorrel gives up her notebooks to join Hobsmere's crew, but the only person who offers to stand behind her is the one she cannot trust.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: The Line Across the Water
episodes.blurb: Sorrel's first match ends level, but the walk home runs straight across the black water where the forty-first bird vanished.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: Seven Shades in Chalk
episodes.blurb: After a night in the drain, Sorrel and Joan chalk out a plan for the Seven while a gale warning settles over Saturday's match.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: The Eighth Nearest
episodes.blurb: In a Fen gale Sorrel holds the flock with the Seven, and the one bird that refuses to be counted stays right beside her.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: The Tide Table
episodes.blurb: The sea comes in over Ketterby's flats and ruins every plan Sorrel made, and a letter from the Loft Court is waiting at the Dyke Arms.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: The Rule as Written
episodes.blurb: A copper ring in the reed and a Court inquiry put the Seven on trial, and the Clerk has a question of her own for Sorrel.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: The Full Minute
episodes.blurb: Tarrow Dyke have learned to drop the Seven, and Sorrel must choose between the shape she wants and the minute she owes the Breath.

episodes.title: Chapter 9: The First Ring
episodes.blurb: Fallowby's protest costs Hobsmere a player before the last match, and Sorrel finds a number in the Loft's old books that nobody was meant to ask about.

episodes.title: Chapter 10: Six Cannot Hold
episodes.blurb: One match, one point bird, and a ring that no one on the Reedbed can cut.
